results.title: Jennifer
results.overview: Jennifer is an Indian movie directed by Althaf Rahman starring Swasika. The feature film is produced by Antony Naduvattom and Binu Dev

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 8
results.overview: The eighth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 14, 2026, at Nagoya Kinjo Pier Arena in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan and featured two second-round matches.

results.title: Ultra Sound
results.overview: After a positive pregnancy test leads Wyn to discover she has no uterus, her life of sweeping romance is turned upside down, forcing her into a sudden and unexpected growth years later.

results.title: Differently Different – What Connects Us
results.overview: Origins draw circles, language shapes memory – and sometimes the feeling of being different remains. Some lose their origins, others carry a heavy family legacy, still others feel foreign in their own land. Director Hao Hohl guides us through a mosaic of moments about belonging and what connects us.

results.title: Ghost School
results.overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption, and a wall of silence.

results.title: Ceremony
results.overview: When the Nuxalk trace their vanished ooligan alongside a land claim filed the day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground, where an older law insists: the fish and the people return together or not at all.

results.title: This is Not a French Film
results.original_title: Ceci n’est pas un film français
results.overview: Tired of being offered the same cliché roles over again, Tom, a committed Franco-Beninese actor decides to make his first feature film with non-white performers. Through a film-within-a-film approach, the ensemble challenges norms and works toward empowerment.

results.title: Buyer Beware
results.overview: A hilarious new horror story by upcoming director ‘Tommy Linguey’ - Coming Soon

results.title: Breach
results.overview: Five haunting visions of the future collide in this gripping sci-fi anthology where technology spirals out of control, society begins to collapse, and humanity is pushed to its limits.

results.title: Far from Maine
results.overview: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

results.title: Axanar: The Gathering Storm
results.overview: Set during the Four Years War between the Federation and the Klingon Empire, Axanar: The Gathering Storm continues the story begun in Prelude to Axanar. Captain Garth of Izar and his crew face the escalating conflict that will ultimately lead to the legendary Battle of Axanar.

results.title: Infectious
results.overview: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.

results.title: Candidates of Death
results.overview: A father goes on holiday with his son and two of his friends, during which time they make an amateur horror film together. As the years pass, they continue to shoot scenes for their “handcrafted,” carefree, imaginative horror project, with even more passion, dutiful consistency, and unwavering commitment: the documentary chronicles a decade of this beautiful adventure, as Maciej and the kids become a group of people who grow up… and yet somehow still manage to grow younger together.

results.title: Heat
results.overview: Climate change disrupts lives and relationships – especially in the Persian Gulf, where temperatures can exceed 50°C and society is divided between the privileged few who can protect themselves, and migrants who have no choice but to endure the heat in order to make ends meet.

results.title: The Experiment
results.overview: Mat Fraser and Sophie Morgan invite members of the public to take part in a provocative experiment inside a brand new “progressive” residential facility. Visitors are encouraged to take a closer look, meet the residents, and discover a very different type of care. But as the experiment unfolds, nothing is quite as it seems. As events take an increasingly unsettling turn and troubling ideas begin to emerge, will anyone question what’s really going on?

results.title: My Home of Wind and Sand
results.original_title: My Home of Wind and Sand
results.overview: Since birth, Najla has lived in a refugee camp in the Algerian Sahara. Over the course of ten years, the film follows the activist as she peacefully advocates for Western Sahara's independence.

results.title: Far Away Close to You
results.original_title: សែនឆ្ងាយ ក្បែរអ្នក
results.overview: Seventeen-year-old Sota from the vibrant Phnom Penh, is sent to a quiet rural town to finish high school. Struggling to fit in, she feels adrift, until she meets Viphu, a kind-hearted boy whose determination to uplift his community sparks a bond neither expected.  Together they discover friendship and love. But as graduation nears, ambition and circumstance begin to pull them apart. Misunderstandings deepen, silence grows, and their paths diverge.  Yet even as distance separates them, a question lingers: is their story truly over, or only waiting to begin again?

results.title: Conversation with the Sea
results.overview: In Jerusalem, Kamal, a 60-year-old Palestinian man, is ordered by an Israeli court to pay a large social security debt allegedly owed by his son Wael. But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

results.title: Rabb Da Radio 3
results.overview: A village's unity is tested by a new highway project that sparks greed and conflict.
